events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, the iconic co-founder, co-lead vocalist, and rhythm guitarist of The Beatles, who would have turned 86 today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Imagine a world without John Lennon's music. His vision and artistry continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric or Beatles track he spearheaded?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary British actor, comedian, screenwriter, and Monty Python co-founder, John Cleese.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, John Cleese has given us some of the most unforgettable comedy moments. What's your top Cleese character or sketch?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released in 1968
events.blurb: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their ninth studio album, 'The Beatles', famously known as the 'White Album'.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles gave us the sprawling masterpiece that is the 'White Album'. Which track from the double LP is on repeat for you?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, lead vocalist of Queen, who passed away on this day in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Tribute to Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost one of music's greatest showmen, Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released in 1965
events.blurb: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul'.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: It's been 61 years since The Beatles shifted gears with 'Rubber Soul'. An album that marked a creative leap for the Fab Four. What are your stand-out tracks?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who tragically passed away on this day in 1980 at the age of 40.

angles.name: Lennon's Passing
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the world lost a musical visionary. John Lennon's message of peace and love resonates as strongly as ever.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Celebrating the life and legacy of David Bowie, the influential singer-songwriter and actor, who would have turned 80 today.

angles.name: Bowie's 80th
angles.copy: Eighty years since the birth of the Starman. David Bowie's impact on music, fashion, and culture is simply immeasurable. Which Bowie era is your favourite?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis's 92nd
angles.copy: Ninety-two years since Elvis Presley changed music forever. His legend lives on. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary guitarist and founder of Led Zeppelin, Jimmy Page.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young for the architect of Led Zeppelin's sound, Jimmy Page. His riffs are etched into rock history. What's his most iconic guitar moment?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 82nd birthday to the distinctive voice of Sir Rod Stewart.

angles.name: Rod the Mod's Birthday
angles.copy: Eighty-two today for the one and only Rod Stewart! A career spanning decades and countless hits. What's your favourite Rod Stewart tune?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the charismatic frontman of the iconic British band Madness.

angles.name: Madness Frontman
angles.copy: Sixty-six today for the Nutty Boy himself, Suggs! From 'Our House' to 'Baggy Trousers', Madness gave us the soundtrack to a generation. What's your top Madness track?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the smooth-voiced British pop and blue-eyed soul singer, Paul Young.

angles.name: Paul Young's 71st
angles.copy: Seventy-one today for Paul Young! The man behind hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' and 'Every Time You Go Away'. What's your favourite of his classics?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Happy 81st birthday to the legendary country music icon, singer-songwriter, and businesswoman, Dolly Parton.

angles.name: Dolly's 81st
angles.copy: Eighty-one years young for the one and only Dolly Parton! A true force of nature in music and beyond. What's your favourite Dolly moment or song?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That frontman, singer-songwriter, and producer Gary Barlow.

angles.name: Gary Barlow's Birthday
angles.copy: Fifty-six today for Take That's very own Gary Barlow! From boyband sensation to acclaimed songwriter, he's done it all. What's your favourite Gary Barlow or Take That hit?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Happy 77th birthday to the Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter, the voice behind countless 80s hits, Billy Ocean.

angles.name: Billy Ocean's 77th
angles.copy: Seventy-seven today for the legendary Billy Ocean! Get ready to 'Get Outta My Dreams, Get Into My Car' and celebrate his incredible career. What's your favourite Billy Ocean classic?

events.title: First Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony (1989)
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the first-ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held, honouring rock's pioneering artists.

angles.name: Rock Hall Inaugural
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years since the very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction! Who were the inaugural legends to be enshrined? A landmark moment for music history.
